executive_summary.title: Executive Summary
executive_summary.content:
**Investment Recommendation: BUY | Price Target: $200**

Apple Inc. (AAPL) - Market Cap: $2.9T | Current Price: $185

Key Metrics: Revenue $394B | Net Income $97B | FCF $100B | Margins 30%+

Strengths: Ecosystem lock-in, Services growth (22% revenue, 70% margins), Brand premium, $162B cash

Risks: China exposure (19%), App Store regulation, iPhone dependence (52%)

Valuation: DCF $195 | Target $200 (8% upside)

company_history.title: Company History
company_history.content: Founded 1976 by Jobs, Wozniak, Wayne. Key milestones: Apple II (1977), Mac (1984), iPod (2001), iPhone (2007), iPad (2010), Apple Watch (2014), Services expansion (2015+), Apple Silicon (2020), Vision Pro (2023). Tim Cook CEO since 2011. Revenue grew from $108B to $394B under Cook.

leadership_analysis.title: Leadership Analysis
leadership_analysis.content: CEO Tim Cook (since 2011): Operations expert, grew market cap $350B→$2.9T. CFO Luca Maestri: Capital allocation, $600B+ returned to shareholders. COO Jeff Williams: Supply chain excellence. Strong management team with low turnover.

business_model.title: Business Model
business_model.content: Vertically integrated ecosystem: iPhone 52% ($205B), Services 22% ($85B, 70% margins), Mac 10%, iPad 8%, Wearables 8%. 2B+ active devices, 1B+ paid subscriptions. Ecosystem lock-in via hardware/software/services integration. Industry-leading 44% gross margins, 30% operating margins.

financial_analysis.title: Financial Analysis
financial_analysis.content: FY2023: Revenue $394B (+3%), Gross Profit $170B (44% margin), Operating Income $115B (30% margin), Net Income $97B (25% margin), FCF $100B. Balance Sheet: Cash $162B, Debt $111B, Net Cash $51B. ROE 160%, ROIC 45%. 3-year revenue CAGR 8%, Services growing 15%+.

valuation_analysis.title: Valuation Analysis
valuation_analysis.content: DCF Analysis: WACC 8.5%, Terminal growth 3%, Fair Value $195. Multiples: P/E 29.5x (vs 5yr avg 27x), EV/EBITDA 22x, P/FCF 29x. Peer comparison: Premium to MSFT, GOOGL justified by margins and ecosystem. Target Price $200 (8% upside).

market_analysis.title: Market Analysis
market_analysis.content: Smartphone market: 18% share, 75% profit share. Competitors: Samsung, Google, Xiaomi. Tablet: 38% share (dominant). Wearables: 34% smartwatch, 31% earbuds. Services: Competing with Spotify, Netflix, Google. Geographic: Americas 42%, Europe 24%, China 19%, Japan 7%, Asia 8%.

risk_assessment.title: Risk Assessment
risk_assessment.content: Key Risks: 1) China concentration (19% revenue) - geopolitical, competition. 2) Regulatory pressure - App Store 30% fee under scrutiny (EU DMA, US DOJ). 3) iPhone dependence (52% revenue) - maturing market. 4) Innovation pace - fewer breakthrough products. 5) Supply chain - Taiwan semiconductor risk. Mitigation: India expansion, services diversification, R&D investment.
